Odd-part symmetrization preserves the midpoint bound, and the two feasible disjoint-support midpoint defects give the stated additivity bound, which telescopes to the claimed residual estimate. The affine approximation inequalities, nonlinear example and its optimal residual radius, invertible shear, and dual-norm threshold inclusions all follow with their stated quantifiers and normalizations.
